steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Wow... Who'd have thought, Chief is actually not bad at this game! You got so many boxes right!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Roulecca is no cheater. Here, take these gifts as your rewards!
Roulecca shoves all the gifts she's looted from the staff into your arms. You're not sure what to do with them.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You gave me all your gifts. Don't you wanna pick a favorite and keep it?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hehe, but Roulecca's already got her favorite gift!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I'm dressed in my childhood clothes and I've won so many gifts... The Roulecca now has become so much stronger than the little Roulecca...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: If the guys from Four-leaf Clover see how badass Roulecca has become and how many friends Roulecca has made, they must be so proud!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No doubt they will. You'll always be the pride of Four-leaf Clover.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hehe, for sure! Let's keep playing! Roulecca's not done with the game yet! More cookies!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ahem, we can keep on playing, but no more cookies for me. I'm too full...
